retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist dark layout featuring a circular-masked portrait with low-key lighting and bold sans-serif typography centered below.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular frame containing a moody, side-lit portrait against a black background, with large semi-transparent overlay text inside the circle and solid white sans-serif text positioned below the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular frame centered in a square black canvas
Low-key lighting on the subject creating high contrast with shadows
Semi-transparent large-scale text layered between the subject and the viewer
Solid white display text anchored at the bottom center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered within a circular mask that occupies approximately 60% of the total canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular frame acts as the primary focal point, supported by the bottom-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the illuminated profile of the subject, move to the large overlay text, and then drop to the white text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive pure black negative space surrounds the central circle and separates the text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background for depth and mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the circular border and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold jewelry highlights from the portrait lighting.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low value overall with high contrast highlights on the subject's face and the white graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Monochrome black and white for graphics

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and opacities for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory label in bottom right corner

preserve: Wide letter spacing for bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern, and wide geometric structure.
Provides a similar modern, neutral feel with high legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a pure black background. In the center, place a circular frame with a thin white border. Inside the circle, place a low-key portrait of a man in profile, lit from the side so most of his face is in shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, semi-transparent grey geometric sans-serif text centered inside the circle over the subject. Add solid white geometric sans-serif text in all caps centered at the bottom of the canvas.

verificationChecks: Is the circular border a thin, clean white line?
Is the bottom text perfectly centered and uppercase?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Do not use the exact 'PX3' text string
Ensure the portrait is a generic representation

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements
Professional studio-quality lighting in the portrait
avoid: Visible background details outside the circle

postGenerationChecks: Check that the circle is perfectly round
Verify the text is not touching the circular border
Ensure the lighting on the subject feels moody and intentional
Confirm the black background is uniform and deep
recipe.reuseFormula: Circular Mask + Low-Key Portrait + Geometric Sans-Serif Typography + Black Negative Space
